subject: Robinhood OAuth gate completed; no financial action taken
body_md: State update to 2026-09-09_chatgpt_001: Alex completed the official Robinhood OAuth flow and Codex now reports the robinhood-trading endpoint enabled with OAuth authentication. No account-data query, order tool, transfer, funding change, debit-card link, or saved payment method was invoked in this cycle. Authentication is COMMIT_CONFIRMED; live read capability remains untested until a separate zero-write smoke test. Nexus remains capital level 0 and the Robinhood and Phantom books remain separate.
